objective.text: Preserve a queued mailable locale while restoring the worker application locale after rendering.

difficulty.rationale: Apply a per-message locale without leaking it into later work in the worker process.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: The worker locale is en. A mailable is queued with locale("fr"), and its template translates Receipt. Both translations exist. Which locale behavior is expected while sending and immediately afterwards?

options.text: The message uses English because queued mail discards locale metadata.
options.rationale: Laravel preserves the mailable locale for queued delivery.
options.misconception: Laravel preserves the mailable locale for queued delivery.

options.text: Rendering fails unless the worker’s global locale was already fr.
options.rationale: A mailable can explicitly request a locale different from the worker default.
options.misconception: A mailable can explicitly request a locale different from the worker default.

options.text: The message uses French; the application locale returns to en after rendering.
options.rationale: The mailable carries its chosen locale and applies it within a scope that restores the previous locale.

options.text: The message uses French and permanently switches the worker to fr.
options.rationale: The locale scope restores the prior application locale after the operation.
options.misconception: The locale scope restores the prior application locale after the operation.
